videos.title: Jersey
videos.description: Arjun, a gifted yet failed cricketer, makes a daring comeback in his late thirties, driven by his dream of playing for India and fulfilling his son's wish for a jersey.

videos.title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
videos.description: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

videos.title: Hero
videos.description: A barber encounters his ex-lover at a ruthless gang leader's hideout and attempts a daring escape, triggering a chaotic chase as goons pursue them relentlessly.

videos.title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
videos.description: Five years after her husband vanishes, Vasudha rebuilds life as a single mother and finds love with Aarav. But when Hari unexpectedly returns, her world shatters as love and loyalty collide.

videos.title: Saturday Blockbuster- Murder 2
videos.description: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

videos.title: Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!
videos.description: Prem and Nisha fall in love but Pooja's death and family duty force them apart. Rajesh learns the truth and unites them, choosing love over obligation.

videos.title: Jism
videos.description: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.

videos.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
videos.description: Bhaijaan, the eldest brother, stays unmarried to keep peace in the family. But things get complicated when his younger brothers secretly try to make him fall in love.

videos.title: No Entry
videos.description: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

videos.title: Bhoot Bangla
videos.description: Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral legacy.

videos.title: Air India Around The World-English
videos.description: ...Vinglish. Shashi, a housewife and caterer, is mocked for not knowing English. Her journey to learn the language helps her rediscover herself and prove her worth as a mother and wife.

videos.title: Zeher
videos.description: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

videos.title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
videos.description: (Movies @6) Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

videos.title: Sholay
videos.description: Thakur Baldev hires Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar, the dacoit who wiped out his family. They find love along the way, but fate decides otherwise.

videos.title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
videos.description: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the man Reena is set to marry, in an attempt to win her love - but he's unprepared for the chaos that follows when the truth comes out.

videos.title: Pure Bollywood
videos.description: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

videos.title: Prem
videos.description: Sanjay is haunted by visions of his past life as Shantanu. His world shifts when he meets Sonia, who resembles a woman from his visions, drawing him into a mysterious fate.

videos.title: Kalyug
videos.description: Kunal and Renuka's happy marriage is shattered when an intimate video surfaces online. Kunal sets out to expose the culprits behind the illegal racket and seek justice.

videos.title: Baby John
videos.description: DCP Satya Verma fakes his death to shield his daughter from a deadly politician. But when enemies return, he must face his past to protect his family at all costs.

videos.title: Bobby
videos.description: Raja, a wealthy businessman's son, falls head over heels for Bobby, a fisherman's daughter. But with their families against their love, will they fight for their happily ever after.

videos.title: Awarapan
videos.description: (Movies @6) Shivam, a hitman, is ordered to watch a woman. He finds out she's trapped in a trafficking ring and decides to help her reunite with her true love.

videos.title: Udta Punjab
videos.description: A rock star, labourer, doctor, and cop struggle with a drug crisis in Punjab. Their lives intertwine as they fight addiction and chaos.

videos.title: Aparichit-The Stranger
videos.description: Ramanujam, a lawyer with multiple personalities, turns vigilante at night. Guided by Garuda Purana, he hunts down criminals and exposes antisocial elements in society.
